evaluator_identity.rule: the answer-free manifest binds the public commit and byte identity of every required executable and protocol file

canonicalization.sets: arrays with a stable public identity are keyed by that identity and sorted ordinally
canonicalization.form_keys: lowercase plugin filename, colon, eight lowercase hexadecimal local-id digits
canonicalization.missing_and_extra: both are product mismatches after valid comparison admission
canonicalization.unsupported_and_gaps: compare as ordinary typed facts; omission is a mismatch
canonicalization.numbers: integers remain integers; non-integers use invariant JSON number text
canonicalization.strings: ordinal, case-sensitive except where the producing public contract already canonicalizes

aggregation: PASS only when every admitted assertion passes; any product mismatch is FAIL; any pre-comparison evaluator or oracle defect is EVALUATOR_ERROR
